title: Oscar Pettiford sits in at Fatty George's
summary: Armstrong's touring party, including Ella and bassist Oscar Pettiford, met the Straws; Pettiford disliked their style but Zanco admires his bass playing.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Oscar Pettiford now. We're talking about him.

Yeah well, Pettiford didn't, I don't know, he didn't particularly like that style of music we were playing. He plays more on the progressive side, you know. But you really have to appreciate the musicianship. The guy really slaps the bass, man. He's great.
And who else came and sat in?
